metadata.note: The line of contact runs roughly 1,000 km. Through mid-2026 it moved by villages and treelines rather than by regions; ISW assessed Russian gains through July 2026 at well under 2 km² per day.
metadata.editing: The band drawn either side of this line represents the contested zone. Widen or narrow it in lib/mapLayers.ts (layer ctl-front-band).

properties.name: Line of contact
properties.note: From northern Kharkiv oblast, south along the Oskil, through the Donetsk oblast agglomerations, west across Zaporizhzhia, then along the Dnipro to the Black Sea.
